newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 41 Kurd rebels in clashes.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 41 Kurd rebels in clashes.

text.p: Turkish troops have killed 41 Kurdish guerrillas in clashes in the southeast of the country over the last two days, security officials said on Friday.
The emergency rule governor's office said in a statement the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels were killed in fighting on Sirnak province's Cudi mountain and in provinces elsewhere in the region.

Earlier this week almost 130 combatants died in fierce fighting between Turkish soldiers and PKK guerrillas that spilled over into northern Iraq. Troops killed 118 rebels while 11 members of the security forces died.
More than 20,000 people have died in the 12 years since the PKK began its armed struggle for self-rule in the southeast.
